`CLAIM_B.reference.json` and `CLAIM_C.reference.json` are HAND transcriptions of the printed estimates
(checked against the page's own totals: B items = 29,764; C parts 18,855 + labour 21,795 + CGST/SGST 3,923.10 = 44,573.10).
They are test fixtures and the offline `--provider replay` demo input. They are NOT model output.
There is deliberately no Claim A reference: the handwritten amount column has ambiguous digits (see README).
